facts.function: festive dress-up costume portraying an Olympian goddess
facts.form: sleeveless pullover dress with attached drape, two pin-on shoulder medallions, two armbands; raw unfinished edges at drape, back ties and hem

gri_path: GRI 1: Chapter 95 note 1 excludes fancy dress of textile materials of Chapter 61/62, but per CBP practice (Rubie's) flimsy, non-durable costumes with raw unfinished edges are festive articles of heading 9505
GRI 3(b): costume set put up together; the dress gives essential character

rejected_alternatives.reason: costume is flimsy with raw unfinished edges and is not wearing apparel of chapters 61/62
that line covers Halloween/festive masks and other specified items, not textile costumes

classification.rationale: The costume dress has raw, unfinished edges at the drape, back ties and hem, making it a flimsy, non-durable festive article rather than wearing apparel. CBP classifies such goddess-type costumes in 9505.90.6000 (N327404 Love Goddess, in force; N324994 Golden Goddess). The accessories (medallions, armbands) are packed with the dress and follow it as a set. Classification is 9505.90.60.00.
